name: Gates of Ironforge
summary: From Dun Morogh, travelers climb to the Gates of Ironforge, where a stone king guards the way into the dwarven capital. The gates open in the mountain face, with High King Modimus Anvilmar's statue just inside.

sections.title: The Threshold of the Mountain
sections.body: From central Dun Morogh, you climb a winding, fortified ramp through the snowy lowlands to the Gates of Ironforge. Beyond the great portal stands a stone likeness of High King Modimus Anvilmar. He united the dwarven clans before the War of the Three Hammers. The passage opens into the Commons, where Ironforge's trade and banking are centered.

faq.q: Where do the Gates of Ironforge lead?
faq.answer: The Gates of Ironforge lead from Dun Morogh into Ironforge. You emerge in the southwestern Commons, the city's center of trade and banking.

faq.q: Who is the statue inside the gates depicting?
aliases: who is the statue at the gate
faq.answer: The statue just inside the entrance depicts High King Modimus Anvilmar. He ruled all dwarven clans before political rifts divided them into the Bronzebeard, Wildhammer, and Dark Iron factions.

faq.q: How do you reach the gates from Dun Morogh?
faq.answer: From central Dun Morogh, head north and climb the broad, fortified stone ramp cut into the mountainside. It leads straight to the fortress's outer threshold.

angles.text: Beneath High King Modimus Anvilmar's likeness, remember the ancient era when all dwarven clans lived beneath one mountain as a single kin.
You enter the Gates of Ironforge, one of the Alliance's most fortified strongholds. From Dun Morogh's frigid valleys, it is nearly impossible to besiege.
